footnoteBody: Every row here is append-only: there's no edit or delete affordance anywhere in this UI, only the retention window above, which ages entries out automatically. This is a separate log from the per-task Activity Log in each task drawer — that one tracks task edits for collaborators; this one tracks admin, permission, and access events for compliance. The two are never merged.
emptyHint: Sign-ins, member and role changes, permission changes and project lifecycle events will appear here as they happen.
emptyFilteredTitle: No events match the current filters
emptyFilteredHint: Try a wider date range or clear some filters.

retentionHint: PCI DSS minimum is {{pciMonths}} months, with the most recent 3 months immediately accessible. Entries are purged by age only — never manually deletable.
retentionOwnerOnly: Only the workspace owner can change retention.
retentionCardDescription: How long entries in Admin Center > Security > Audit Log are kept. Older entries are purged automatically by age; they can never be edited or deleted by hand.
retentionDefaultNote: Default: {{months}}. PCI DSS requires at least {{pciMonths}} months.
retentionBelowPciWarning: This is shorter than the PCI DSS minimum of {{pciMonths}} months.
retentionUpdated: Retention window updated to {{months}}. Entries older than this will be purged on the next cycle.
retentionUpdateError: Couldn't update the retention window. Please try again.
retentionShortenContent: Entries older than {{months}} will be permanently purged on the next retention cycle. This cannot be undone.
